# Smobler

> An AI-first digital agency and technology solutions provider working across AI,
> blockchain and intelligent digital experiences. Founded by Dr. Loretta Chen,
> headquartered in Singapore with a presence in Honolulu, Hawai'i. Backed by
> Enterprise Singapore, IMDA, Brinc and Animoca Brands.

Smobler's founding premise is "do good, do well" — work that is commercially
serious and does something worth doing. The studio operates across four
capability pillars, and also builds and operates its own game IP.

## Capabilities

- AI cost optimisation — Slashboard, for multi-model spend, latency and token telemetry
- AI for food security — NUTRA and Robin AI, generating FDA-compliant nutrition labels and HACCP plans
- AI business workflows — autonomous agents for lead qualification, support, voice booking and document extraction
- Blockchain for maritime trade — digital bunkering settlement on Sui
- Phygital activations — led by NOVA

## Selected work

- [NUTRA — Robin](https://smobler.io/work/nutra): AI food-compliance platform for Hawai'i food entrepreneurs, with Leeward Community College and WVAPDC
- [Digital Bunkering](https://smobler.io/work/digital-bunkering): Blockchain settlement for maritime bunkering on Sui
- [NOVA](https://smobler.io/work/nova): Makers. Meets. Metaverse. — the studio's phygital event platform
- [Aloha Pathways](https://smobler.io/work/aloha-pathways): Statewide career navigation system
- [Sage](https://smobler.io/work/sage): FinTech platform
- [Twinity](https://smobler.io/work/twinity): AI platform
